d92e7789c581.title: PC-BP-09: WHO-hosted PCMT Catalogue Access, Copy, and Export Workflow
d92e7789c581.content: Process_PC_BP_09_PCMT_Access · strict (defaulted) · 6 step(s) . Operational realization of PC-BP-09 (WHO-hosted PCMT Onboarding and Catalogue Access, Ch 6, section 6.2, pp. 46-47, Figure 14) in the SMART Product Catalogue Management Tool (PCMT). WHOGroup imports global source catalogues (GMDN, INN, WHO EML, EMDN) and publishes Catalogues -> WHO. Country user groups (CAGroup, CBGroup) are granted read-only access to Catalogues -> WHO and ownership/edit access only to their respective country catalogues (Catalogues -> CA, Catalogues -> CB) as governed by decision table PC-DT-03. i i i i i i

7188c211cfa3.doc: PC-BP-09: WHO-hosted PCMT Catalogue Access, Copy, and Export Workflow
7188c211cfa3.title: Steps
7188c211cfa3.content: Every one of the 6 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Import Source Catalogues & Publish Catalogues -> WHOTask_ImportPublishWHO | WHO Group (WHOGroup) | — | WHOGroup imports global source catalogues (GMDN, INN, WHO EML, EMDN) and publishes common product records in Catalogues -> WHO (Ch 6, pp. 46-47, Fig. 14). | . | Browse Catalogues -> WHO (View-Only) & Request Product Copy or Country EditTask_BrowseSelectWHO | Country User Group (CAGroup / CBGroup) | — | Country user group (CAGroup / CBGroup) browses Catalogues -> WHO in view-only mode and requests a product copy or country catalogue edit (Ch 6, pp. 46-47, Fig. 14). | . | Evaluate Catalogue Access Matrix (PC-DT-03: userGroup x catalogue)Task_EvalAccessMatrix | WHO-hosted PCMT Access Control & Copy Engine | — | WHO-hosted PCMT evaluates the PC-DT-03 access decision table for the requesting userGroup and target catalogue (view, edit, own, or none). | . | Copy Selected GenericProduct / TradeItem from Catalogues -> WHO to Country CatalogueTask_CopyFromWHOToCountry | WHO-hosted PCMT Access Control & Copy Engine | — | PCMT copy engine associates or copies selected GenericProduct and TradeItem attributes from Catalogues -> WHO into the designated Country Catalogue (Ch 6, p. 46, Fig. 14). | . | Edit Owned Country Catalogue (Catalogues -> CA / CB) & Attach ProductAuthorizationTask_EditCountryCatalogue | Country User Group (CAGroup / CBGroup) | — | Country user group curates country-specific identifiers and attaches national regulatory ProductAuthorization attributes in its owned Country Catalogue (Catalogues -> CA or CB, PC-DT-02). | . | Export & Synchronize Country Catalogue to National eLMIS / ERPTask_ExportSynchronize | Country User Group (CAGroup / CBGroup) | — | PCMT exports and synchronizes approved Country Catalogue product master data to national supply chain systems (eLMIS, WMS, ERP). | .

fad328880def.title: Every process — one page each
fad328880def.content: Each page shows the diagram, what it is for, who acts in it, every step with the skill it runs, and which processes call it. kg:audit’s process-diagram-published fails a diagram no page shows — 45 of 62 were in that state before these pages existed (bean ooq3). Running instances links each workflow instance’s own page — the diagram with its token, its stuck states, its beans and todos — for every instance running this process or calling it as a subprocess. This section reported them as defects in its first version, and that was wrong: beans luke and uuhu worked this corpus from 90 down to this remainder and settled what is left. luke: “coverage is deliberately NOT gated — a human sign-off step has no skill”. uuhu added the call-activity exemption and recorded that its own remainder “are not gaps”. 0 are call activities, which delegate to a subprocess — the skill is named there, and naming it twice would be one fact in two places. The other 6 are listed by lane, because the lane is what says whether a person, a pipeline or an agent performs the step, and only the last of those has a skill to run. | lane | steps | . | Country User Group (CAGroup / CBGroup) | 3 | . | WHO-hosted PCMT Access Control & Copy Engine | 2 | . | WHO Group (WHOGroup) | 1 | . No verdict is offered on which of these is a gap, and that is the honest state rather than a hedge: distinguishing a person’s judgement step from an agent step somebody forgot needs the lane’s actor KIND, which a free-text lane name does not give — process-model.ts notes sixty lanes spell two dozen positions. The lane’s partitionElementRef is the join that would answer it, and it is present on 4 of these 6 steps — which is the measurement, not an impression. An earlier draft of this sentence said few of these and was counting whether the lane had a NAME, a different question with a different answer.
